title: ZCC trusted networks
aliases: am i on a trusted network

prose.text: Client Connector's trusted networks answer one question for the forwarding profile: is this device on one of the organization's networks right now? Three parts of the KB cover them.

items.label: How the app decides.
items.text: The criteria, Any or All, predefined networks, VPN adapter options and when the app re-evaluates: [[zcc.trusted-networks.detection]].

items.label: What the answer changes.
items.text: The device becomes On-Trusted and gets that network type's actions: [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.network-types]], [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.internet-actions]], [[zcc.forwarding-profiles.private-access-actions]].

items.label: The reusable object and its API.
items.text: [[zcc.trusted-networks.object]], and how Terraform bridges its two API generations: [[zcc.terraform.trusted-network-backend]].

prose.text: ZPA has its own read-only trusted network records and a TRUSTED_NETWORK policy condition, fed from these: [[zpa.trusted-networks]], [[zpa.trusted-networks.zcc-relationship]].
